author: Lenin, V. I.
title: Collected Works
edition: English edition, 45 vols, 1960–1970; vol. 24 trans. Bernard Isaacs, vol. 26 trans. Yuri Sdobnikov and George Hanna
notes: The standard English edition of Lenin's writings, and the text this pack quotes for the April Theses (vol. 24) and for the Military Revolutionary Committee's proclamation of 25 October (vol. 26). It is a Soviet edition: the translations are reliable, the selection and the editorial notes are not neutral, and the volumes were produced by a state whose founding this pack is about. Read for what the documents say, not for what the apparatus says about them. Full text at the Marxists Internet Archive.
